Half a Day in a Leave Allocation

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn how to give half a day or other fractions of a day in an allocation, without saving anything.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Management menu

Open the Management menu.

3. Allocations

Click Allocations.

4. New

Click New to create an allocation.

5. Type half a day

Type 0.5, then press Tab.

6. Check the days

Look at the duration. Click the field to continue.

7. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
